name: Next.js
source: Official Next.js upgrade guides, read 2026-11-06. Add a guide entry per major step; items must come from the guide text, never from memory.

items.title: react and react-dom must be 19 or newer
items.change: Install next, react, react-dom and eslint-config-next at latest; with TypeScript also upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom. Replace useFormState with useActionState.

items.title: cookies, headers, draftMode, params and searchParams are now asynchronous
items.change: Use await cookies(), await headers(), await draftMode(); type params and searchParams as Promise and await them (or use React use() in synchronous components). The official codemod can do this.

items.title: runtime = 'experimental-edge' now errors
items.change: Change the runtime segment config to 'edge'.

items.title: fetch requests are no longer cached by default
items.change: Pass cache: 'force-cache' on requests that should stay cached, or export const fetchCache = 'default-cache' from a layout or page.

items.title: GET route handlers are no longer cached by default
items.change: Add export const dynamic = 'force-static' to handlers that should be cached.

items.title: Page segments are no longer reused from the client cache on navigation
items.change: To keep the old behaviour set experimental.staleTimes (dynamic: 30, static: 180 in the guide's example).

items.title: @next/font package removed
items.change: Import from next/font/google or next/font/local instead of @next/font.

items.title: experimental.bundlePagesExternals and experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages are now stable and renamed
items.change: Rename to bundlePagesRouterDependencies and serverExternalPackages, moved out of experimental.

items.title: Automatic Speed Insights instrumentation removed
items.change: Follow the Vercel Speed Insights Quickstart if you still want it.

items.title: NextRequest geo and ip properties removed
items.change: Read the value from your host instead; on Vercel use geolocation() and ipAddress() from @vercel/functions.
